introduction: South Carolina weatherization applications go to the Community Action provider serving your county. Ask for its current home-assessment and income checklist.
description: South Carolina weatherization applications go to the Community Action provider serving your county. Ask for its current home-assessment and income checklist.

sections.who: The state considers residence, income and need for help with energy costs. Priority includes older adults, households with disabilities and families with children.
sections.get: Approved work improves the home’s energy performance to reduce energy use.
sections.docs:
• Household income and members.
  • Address and energy bills.
  • Property and permission records requested by the provider.
sections.apply:
1. Find the county provider

    Use OEO’s Community Action link.

  2. Complete local intake

    Confirm current financial and home requirements.

  3. Arrange the review

    Provide access and discuss any required permissions or waiting list.
sections.after: Ask the agency about the assessment and proposed work. OEO describes an appeal route beginning with the local agency.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Weatherization eligibility, intake and appeal. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The Community Action agency serving weatherization in your county.
The state lists older adults, disabilities and children as preference groups.
OEO directs you first to notify the county agency and request review.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
